//: Coverage config for the backend (functions/) node suite, driven by `npm run functions:coverage` (c8 wrapping scripts/run-functions-tests.mjs). The frontend (src/) is measured separately by Vitest — see vitest.config.js, which excludes functions/. `all: true` instruments every functions/ source file, including ones never loaded by a test (e.g. the onCall/onRequest handlers in index.js), so the number reflects the true backend gap rather than only the files a test happened to require. Thresholds are a RATCHET set just under the current baseline: raise them as backend coverage improves so it can only go up.
//baseline: Measured baseline 2026-07-28: lines/statements 59.94%, branches 78.61%, functions 80.92% (198 backend test files, after the Core extractions of cron/dispatcher/questionReview/classManagement/invoiceGenerator/studentAgents/weeklyParentDigest). Thresholds sit a small buffer under that so the gate can only ratchet up; bump them again the next time coverage rises. Previously 2026-07-27: 53.3/77.48/79.73 (184 files). Note the denominator is honest and can move: a new test that loads a previously-unloaded module (e.g. cala.test.js pulling in cbcKnowledge.js) adds that module's real function/branch counts to the universe, which can dip a percentage even as absolute coverage rises — cover the newly-loaded module rather than lowering the bar (that is what the teacherTools syllabiCurriculumData/syllabusTopicTree/curriculumModuleSchema tests exist for).
//measure-it-the-way-CI-does: MEASURE WITH functions/node_modules ABSENT. CI installs only the root package (`npm ci`), so a require that resolves on a developer machine fails there, that module is never loaded, and its lines never count. The same commit measured 54.42/77.22/82.00 with functions/ deps installed and 53.30/77.48/79.73 without — a full point of lines and two of functions. Bumping this file from the higher number sets a threshold CI cannot reach and turns the ratchet into a broken gate. Reproduce CI with: mv functions/node_modules /tmp && npm run functions:coverage && mv /tmp/node_modules functions/
//branches: Branches is the one number that did not rise with the others, and the reason is worth knowing before someone 'fixes' it: functions/shared/assessment moved ~1,800 lines of rule code into this scope, and rule code is mostly branches. Its own tests brought the total back above the threshold rather than the threshold down to it — see functions/shared/README.md. Do not lower this to make a red build green.
